It’s been over 500 days of Modi’s third term and the “New India” promise is starting to look like an old rerun. From broken highways and crumbling infrastructure to rising corruption and arrogant ministers, the system feels more stuck than ever.

Modi 3.0 is chasing populism: pushing reservation ceilings above 50% in Bihar, Maharashtra, and Madhya Pradesh, while ignoring reform and efficiency. No big initiatives, no bold policies, just PR and policy U-turns. Meanwhile, E20 fuel chaos, overcrowded railways, and silence on ground-level corruption say it all.

Has Modi 3.0 become UPA 2.0 with better branding? Let’s talk about it.
